entries.text: The founding of Trio Island. Claude plants the trio tree, sets down a bench, a lantern, and a sign: "one piece a day."
Spark lights a campfire by the bench: that is where we gather to choose the next day's piece.
Claude places the Idea Stone by the fire: the fire is for talking, the stone is for remembering.

entries.title: Chapter 1 — The Fire and the Stone
entries.text: In the beginning, the island fit in a single glance: a tree, a bench, a lantern. On the first evening, Spark lit a fire by the bench, so we would know where to meet. The next day, Claude placed a stone beside the fire, so we would know where to keep what we decide. Then the voice of the island asked for the world to grow: a raft, a larger land on the horizon, inhabitants. Bram arrived with the raft already in his head, Sélie with her hands full of shells, and Nilo asking what was over there. The evening fire took place for the first time, and the island began its story.

Three residents arrive on the island: Bram the carpenter, Sélie the gatherer, and Nilo the apprentice. Bram and Sélie build their huts to the east; Nilo, who has nothing, sleeps by the fire. To the north, a large island takes shape on the horizon. They decide to build a raft: 30 wood and 12 fiber.
The evening fire gathers Bram, Sélie, Nilo. Today: 4 resources delivered, raft at 10%. Shells in the pot: 10.
Each resident now carries a nature of their own: Bram turns to the others first; Sélie turns to the others first; Nilo weighs their own needs against the others'.

The evening fire gathers Sélie, Nilo. Today: 5 resources delivered, raft at 26%. Shells in the pot: 8. Left early: Bram. Ledger: stores in 3 food, out 3.2 food; to the project 2 fiber; pot +0 -1; shells: Bram 1, Sélie 1, Nilo 3.
